Name: Lustdew Valley girlification
Author: Lardlady
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]I decided I wanted a feminized interior for the club featured in Lustdew Valley, so I started cooking.[/color][/size]

[b][size=4]Main features[/size][/b]
It replaces all the patrons with more feminine looking ones, turns purnuses into strapons, changes the television broadcast to also feature strapons, gives the shopkeeper nips, and changes the raccoon into a female, still penis-having, raccoon. 
Text is also changed to reflect the genderbenderization, but trash items are left as is, just imagine the raccoon is very active.

Note: The animations when interacting are untouched, because they do not work for me. If they do for you, let me know and I'll  replace them too!

I left Sam alone, cause he's just chillin

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]First, install Lustdew Valley and its dependencies as you normally would, then right click Lustdew Valley in your vortex modlist, press "Open in file manager", open the "LUSTDEW VALLEY" folder, and drop this contained  "[CP] Lustdew Valley" folder into it, where a folder of the same name exists, and press "overwrite" when prompted. 

For uninstallation, simply delete the Lustdew Valley folder and re-download the mod to restore it to its original state.[/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]TrashRacc1124's Lustdew Valley and its dependencies.[/color]
